requirements.RC-1345: Skipped critical tests forbid final release.
requirements.RC-1346: Mandatory requirements with TODO state forbid final release.

requirements.RC-1349: Lorem ipsum may not remain in production.
requirements.RC-1350: Mandatory features may not rely on coming-soon placeholders at final release.
